name: Khudiram Bose
seoTitle: Khudiram Bose: Jugantar Revolutionary and Early Anti-Colonial Martyr
seoDescription: Profile of Khudiram Bose, the Bengali revolutionary linked to Jugantar, the Swadeshi-era underground, and the 1908 Muzaffarpur bombing case.
shortAnswer: Khudiram Bose was a Bengali anti-colonial revolutionary associated with Jugantar who was executed in 1908 after the Muzaffarpur bombing case.
contribution: He joined Bengal's revolutionary underground during the Swadeshi era and took part in the 1908 Muzaffarpur attack aimed at Magistrate Douglas Kingsford.
context: After the 1905 Partition of Bengal, underground networks such as Jugantar pushed parts of anti-colonial politics toward clandestine action and bomb attacks against colonial officials.
impact: His execution at age eighteen made him one of the earliest martyr figures of revolutionary nationalism in Bengal.
highlight: A teenage revolutionary whose execution became a lasting symbol of militant anti-colonial resistance in Bengal.
